# Section 1: Load "penguins" dataset
```{r}

data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")

```
The names of the variables in this dataset are `r colnames(penguins)`.

The species of penguin included in this dataset are `r unique(penguins$species)` and the islands included in this dataset are `r unique(penguins$island)`.

The dataset has `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables.

The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)`.
